data_description.source_name: A friendly name for this external data source.
data_description.sample_method: Capture a real test request, or paste an example JSON payload instead.
data_description.stale_after: Seconds without a valid payload before the selected entities become unavailable. Use 0 to keep the last values available indefinitely.
data_description.local_only: Reject requests that do not come from the local network. Leave this off if an internet-hosted service needs to send data. When Home Assistant Cloud is available, HTTP Data Bridge automatically uses a Nabu Casa cloudhook.
data_description.enabled: Disable this source without deleting its mappings, entities, or webhook ID.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure push source
reconfigure.description: Change source settings and decide whether to keep the current entity mappings or rediscover them from a new payload. The source ID and real webhook ID are preserved.

data_description.sample_method: Keep the existing mappings, or replace them by capturing/pasting a new payload.
data_description.stale_after: Seconds without a valid payload before the selected entities become unavailable. Use 0 to disable expiry.
data_description.local_only: Reject requests that do not come from the local network. When disabled and Home Assistant Cloud is available, the shown webhook URL is a Nabu Casa cloudhook.
data_description.enabled: Disable this source without deleting its mappings, entities, or webhook ID.

sample.title: Paste example JSON
sample.description: Paste one representative payload. It is used only while this setup flow is open and is not saved in the source configuration.

data_description.sample_payload: Objects and arrays are inspected recursively; you will choose the individual scalar values to expose next.

capture.title: Send one test request
capture.description:
Send a JSON POST to the temporary capture URL below, then choose **Continue**.

`{capture_url}`

This temporary endpoint is only for setup and is removed when you continue or leave the flow. The source's permanent webhook URL is shown before saving.

select_fields.title: Choose values
select_fields.description: Select the scalar JSON values that should become Home Assistant entities. Objects and arrays are shown through their individual leaf values.

data_description.unit: Optional. Available for numeric sensors. Boolean values can be exposed as binary sensors.
